meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 先自己在真实界面上做手动 QA(命令、预期、实测、证据),再启动一个 gate reviewer 子代理,对照目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文和 QA 证据审查;QA 无失败行且返回 APPROVE 才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接之前,或你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。

say.text: 对我刚做完的改动跑一次 gate review
say.note: 先手动 QA,再派一个审查代理

say.text: 交接 PR 前帮我审查这个分支
say.note: 核对目标、约束和 QA 证据

say.text: 修复后只复审这次的增量
say.note: 重新派一个只覆盖增量的审查代理

howto.what_en: Claude runs manual QA on the real surface (commands, expected vs observed, evidence), then spawns one gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. PASS needs no failing QA row plus APPROVE.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Run a gate review on the changes I just finished.
say_en.note: Manual QA first, then one reviewer agent.

say_en.text: Review this branch before I hand off the PR.
say_en.note: Checks goal, constraints, and QA evidence.

say_en.text: Re-review only the delta after my fixes.
say_en.note: A fresh reviewer scoped to the delta.
